name: AmiCradle-runtime-x86-stream3d
notes: AmiCradle runtime for the x86 appliance, Stream3D RC1: the whole tuned set (zen, intel, v2 and portable) with one build stamp; the installer checks every SHA-256 and clears stale tuned files. GLQuake timedemo 640x480 on an RX 580: 201 fps (same speed as RC3).
